title: Login latency after auth-service release
root_cause: bcrypt cost factor raised 10->14 in release v6.4.0

title: Portfolio timeouts during ledger-db failover
root_cause: Unplanned ledger-db primary failover; 6 min of refused connections

title: Order failures during exchange partner outage
root_cause: External exchange API outage on the partner side
resolution: Failed over to secondary exchange route; partner fixed

title: notification-service lag after Kafka broker rebalance
root_cause: Partition reassignment caused consumer group rebalancing storm

title: Payment failures: bank partner API outage
root_cause: Bank partner API returned 5xx for 40 minutes (their incident)

title: Settlement mTLS certificate expired
root_cause: Client certificate expired; no renewal automation
resolution: Issued new cert; added expiry alert

title: Cold cache storm after redis failover
root_cause: Redis primary failure promoted an empty replica
resolution: Warmed cache; fixed replica sync checks

title: 401s after JWT signing key rotation
root_cause: Key rotation published new key id before all pods loaded the JWKS

title: Token validation regression after auth library upgrade
root_cause: JWT library upgrade changed clock-skew default

title: Slow orders from ledger-db IOPS throttling
root_cause: Cloud volume burst credits exhausted; IOPS throttled

title: Reporting job full table scans slowed ledger-db
root_cause: New report query without index did sequential scans

title: Settlement consumer stalled after partition reassignment
root_cause: Consumer lost partition assignment during broker maintenance

title: pricing-engine CPU saturation at market open
root_cause: Record market-open volume exceeded provisioned capacity
resolution: Raised replica count; pre-scale before open

title: ledger-db disk full from retained WAL
root_cause: Inactive replication slot retained WAL until disk filled

title: order-service connection pool misconfiguration
root_cause: Datasource pool size overridden by a wrong environment profile

title: HTTP/2 resets after gateway envoy upgrade
root_cause: Envoy upgrade changed HTTP/2 max concurrent streams default
